result.topic_en: Drafts, in Latin and German, of a problem statement asking for the equilibrium distribution of electricity on two infinite parallel perfectly conducting insulated cylinders, and for the force exerted at any point, for certain regular cross-sections.

items.quote:
Datis duobus cylindris infinitis [-&-] inter se parallelis [-...-] [-qui-] perfecte [-conducentibus-] electricitatem conducentibus et
penitus isolatis
[-determinatur distri-] determinatur distributio electricitatis {+in statu aequilibrii+} & vires [-...-] in punctum quodvis positionis exercitae.
items.english: Given two infinite cylinders parallel to each other, perfectly conducting electricity and completely insulated, the distribution of electricity in the state of equilibrium and the forces exerted on any point of position are to be determined.

items.quote:
Es sollen für einige [-...-] Formen des Querschnitts die Vertheilung der Electricitaet [-im-] Gleichgewicht
und die von ihr {+in einem Punkt+} ausgeübten Kräfte bestimmt werden.
items.english: For some forms of the cross-section, the distribution of electricity in equilibrium and the forces exerted by it at a point are to be determined.

items.quote:
Duo cylindri infiniti inter se paralleli electricitatem perfecte conducentes et penitus isolati [-sit electri-]
quantitates datas electricitatis {+pro unitate longitudinis dati repleantur+}
items.english: Two infinite cylinders parallel to each other, perfectly conducting electricity and completely insulated, are filled with given quantities of electricity per unit length; it is asked what the distribution of electricity is and what forces it exerts on any point.
